plan.notes: Official four-year plan page from Seattle University (College of Science and Engineering), 2026-2027. Quarter-Based Degree Plan transcribed. Lecture+lab bundles split into their real course codes at the published split credits (e.g. BIOL 1620 4 cr + BIOL 1621 lab 1 cr). The CHEM/CPSC/ENSC/MATH (5-6 cr) slots transcribed at the 5-cr minimum; the CHEM 1520 (4) / CHEM 1590 (5) choice transcribed at 4 cr; MATH 1028 Trigonometry (2 cr, only if needed) transcribed as a 0-cr choice slot so the published 180-credit minimum is preserved. Quarter sums: 16/16/14/15/15/15/15/15/15/17/15/12 = 180, matching the minimum to graduate. Curriculum notes: at least 25 cr of 3000/4000-level BIOL; BIOL electives (BIOL 2210+) must include one biotechnology/molecular course, one organismal/diversity course, one anatomy/physiology course, and one plant course; C- or better required in prerequisite BIOL/CHEM/MATH. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
